lineWidth.description: When explicitly configured, wraps long values at this column. (CLI: --wrap <column>)

indentWidth.description: Number of spaces per indentation level. (CLI: --space)

useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces. (CLI: --tab)

space.description: Indent all fields with the specified number of spaces. Ignored if tab/useTabs is true.

tab.description: Indent all fields with a tab.

align.description: Insert whitespace between fields and values so that values are visually aligned. Set to a column number, or false/1 to disable.

blankLines.description: Insert an empty line between each entry.

curly.description: Enclose all property values in braces. Quoted values will be converted to braces.

numeric.description: Strip quotes and braces from numeric/month values (e.g. {1998} becomes 1998).

months.description: Convert all months to three letter abbreviations (jan, feb, etc).

sort.description: Sort bibliography entries by citation key (if true) or by specified field list. Prefix field with '-' for descending.

duplicates.description: Check for duplicates (doi, key, abstract, citation). Enabled if merge is set.

merge.description: Merge duplicate entries using the specified strategy.

stripEnclosingBraces.description: Where an entire value is enclosed in double braces, remove the extra braces (e.g. {{Journal}} becomes {Journal}).

dropAllCaps.description: Where values are all caps, make them title case while leaving Roman numerals unchanged.

escape.description: Escape special characters such as umlauts into LaTeX macros. Use 'new' for package-independent LaTeX escapes.

unescape.description: Convert LaTeX escapes to Unicode characters.

sortFields.description: Sort the fields within entries by standard order (if true) or specified field list.

stripComments.description: Remove all comments from the BibTeX source.

trailingCommas.description: End the last key value pair in each entry with a comma.

encodeUrls.description: Replace invalid URL characters with percent encoded values.

removeEmptyFields.description: Remove any fields that have empty values.

removeDuplicateFields.description: Only allow one of each field in each entry.

generateKeys.description: Replace entry citation key with a new key generated from a template pattern.

maxAuthors.description: Truncate authors if above a given number into 'and others'.

lowercase.description: Lowercase field names and entry type.

enclosingBraces.description: Enclose the given fields in double braces so case is preserved during BibTeX compilation.

removeBraces.description: Remove curly braces within field values unless part of a command.

wrap.description: Wrap long values at the given column. true uses 80; false disables wrapping.

omit.description: Remove specified fields from bibliography entries.

lineEnding.description: Overrides dprint's global newLineKind. Omit it to use the global setting, including auto.
